description: This file defines the ProductRelationship entity class, which models relationships between products in the shopizer e-commerce platform. It includes fields for product, related product, store, code, and active status, along with JPA annotations for ORM mapping.

classes.name: ProductRelationship
classes.description: Entity representing relationships between products, including references to the product, related product, store, and status flags.

methods.name: getId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the product relationship.

methods.name: setId
methods.description: Sets the ID of the product relationship.

methods.name: getStore
methods.description: Returns the MerchantStore associated with the relationship.

methods.name: setStore
methods.description: Sets the MerchantStore associated with the relationship.

methods.name: getProduct
methods.description: Returns the primary product in the relationship.

methods.name: setProduct
methods.description: Sets the primary product in the relationship.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the code associated with the relationship.

methods.name: setCode
methods.description: Sets the code associated with the relationship.

methods.name: isActive
methods.description: Checks if the relationship is active.

methods.name: setActive
methods.description: Sets the active status of the relationship.
